notes.title: Tips, Mods, Profile now localised + Improved new player experience
notes.notes:
[p][b]V1.1.2-beta - "Too Early" indicator + More Localisation Updates![/b]

[b]"Too Early" Indicator[/b]
We have added a [b]new "Too Early" visual indicator[/b] to help guide beginners who are new to MuseSwipr. This is something that experienced players will rarely see - though there is an option to turn it off completely in the options. There's more information about what this is and why we included later in the update log.

[b]Localisation Updates[/b]
This update also comes with more localisation coverage! Places like the "Quick Tips" (previously known as "Hot keys"), Mods panel, and in-game profile now use localised strings. We also updated a few localisations based on community contributions. THANK YOU TO OUR AMAZING COMMUNITY <3

Want to help out with localising MuseSwipr to other languages and get your name in the (soon-to-be-added) credits section of the game? Join our [url="https://discord.gg/NQ7UvKaU6z"]Discord[/url] and join the localisation and translation channel!

[b]More Info[/b]
The "Too Early" indicator will appear if the player swipes in a lane or into a lane where there is a note - but it's too early to be registered as an "OK". This seems to happen quite frequently for new-comers due to slow note speeds, and also because they're still learning that swiping is the input and that it's not about "catching" the notes. This usually ends up in a chain of wrong lanes, or a chain of misses due to note lock.

Thanks to all of the people who have shared their MuseSwipr first-time experiences with the online world.
(By the way, if you make MuseSwipr content... share it with the MuseSwipr community on Steam or on Discord!!! Also... join our MuseSwipr [url="https://discord.gg/NQ7UvKaU6z"]Discord[/url]!)[/p]

notes.title: 🎉 Big Changes Coming to MuseSwipr! 🎶
notes.notes:
We’ve got some [b]exciting news[/b] to update you all with as we continue making the [b]MuseSwipr experience even better[/b]!

[h2]🎶 On-going MuseSwipr Editor Updates 🎶[/h2]

As some of you may know, we've been working on a [b]updated version of the MuseSwipr editor[/b] (known as "[b]Editor v2[/b]") which is currently separate from the MuseSwipr game itself. We're working hard behind the scenes on [b]Editor v2[/b], which will eventually be [b]built into the game[/b] - though, this is a [b]big project[/b].

As part of this ongoing update to MuseSwipr's editor, [b]we want to phase out 'v1' maps by removing Editor v1 (the current in-game editor) in the next update[/b]. 
In the mean time, you can still make your own [b]custom maps using Editor v2[/b] which you can grab from our [b][url=https://discord.com/invite/NQ7UvKaU6z]Discord[/url][/b], or the [b][url=https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1IQtTCEYl7eEXwqOLzSbsTJ2MHSG-Jfnt?usp=sharing]Google Drive link[/url][/b].

If you've got some Editor v1 maps you want to convert to the v2 format, here's what you can do:
1. Open the Timing Point Panel (F6) in your map
2. Hit Ctrl+G to copy your map
3. Paste them into Editor v2 with Ctrl+V

(V1 maps that are on the Steam workshop will continue to work, so no need worry about those!)
If you need any support, feel free to reach out to us on the [url=https://discord.com/invite/NQ7UvKaU6z]MuseSwipr Discord[/url]!

[h2]👀 What's Next? 👀[/h2]
Updates have been a little bit sparse, but that's because we have been working hard behind the scenes on big updates! We want the community to have something to look forward to though, so here's a sneak peek of some of the big things we're working on:

🎨 [b]UI visual overhaul[/b] - giving MuseSwipr a less... 'derivative' look when it comes to the user interface... and adding a ton of features based on feedback!

🏆 [b]Scoring updates, better leaderboards, and... a ranking system??[/b]

🎶 And of course, more [b]built-in songs from amazing featured artists[/b]!

We’re super excited about what’s coming next, and we couldn’t do it without our amazing community (speaking of, you should totally join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/NQ7UvKaU6z]Discord here: https://discord.com/invite/NQ7UvKaU6z[/url])
